Kyle / Hannah — quick technical note ahead of the call so we can focus on open design questions during the session.

Key items well want to validate / that you may want to confirm with NetOps prior to the meeting:
- Required outbound ports: 443 (primary), 853/123 (DNS/NTP) — we also support explicit IP allowlists if you prefer.
- Egress model: recommend NAT gateway + egress proxy for controlled telemetry; we can walk through private link options for full isolation.
- Bastion/jump host: for any manual admin tasks we expect a hardened bastion with MFA and restricted IP access.
- HSM/KMS: confirm whether you want Redwood to call customer-managed HSM (KMIP/PKCS#11) or bring-your-own-key via KMS integrations.
- Air-gap install: outline for offline install media, required checksums, and transfer appliance handoff. Also want to review patching cadence for air-gapped nodes.
- Network capture & packet inspection: acceptable for debugging? We usually recommend limited captures under NDA.

If you can attach the network topology (svg/pdf) and a brief summary of compliance controls well annotate the doc and ship notes before the meeting. Ive put a list of our standard config knobs in the preflight checklist Hannah attached.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Lead Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
